findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "We help businesses grow without the guesswork." → 4 lines (7 words, 72px); "Built by someone who actually runs businesses." → 3 lines (7 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "What We Do" above "Three ways we move the needle."; "About" above "Built by someone who actually runs busin"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 4 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "What We Do", "Services", "Company", "Contact").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 4 gradient fill(s): div.hero-glow → radial-gradient(50% 50% at 50% 0%, rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.12), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%) | div.hero-bg → radial-gradient(at 20% 50%, rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.08) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%), radial-gradient(at 80% 20%, rgb | div.hero-visual-inner → linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.08), rgba(120, 113, 108, 0.05))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 4 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): nav.nav-hidden 1440px | section.section-stats 1440px | footer 1440px | div.footer-bottom 1104px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 6 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Coming soon" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "Coming soon" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "Marketing" 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "AI-powered marketing and automation for " 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.9:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The margins differ: 168px on the left, 232px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1424px at 1716px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 4 screens in a row: "Three ways we move the needle."
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: Little motion: 13 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 433px of the width empty: "Built by someone who actually runs businesses.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: A 464px stretch at 680px holds nothing.
findings.fix: Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.

findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
